objective: Compile an inactive experimental Academy Graph Steward candidate that can maintain an isolated draft review queue while every graph acceptance, merge, publication, credential, payment, and permission decision remains human-owned.

deliverables.description: A compiled but inactive Agent Pack, least-privilege policy, and evidence receipt that remains experimental until human, security, and drift proof is supplied.

context.audience: Named Academy graph owners, privacy authorities, institutional reviewers, and agent-runtime operators

stakes.rationale: A steward could poison public learning paths or widen authority if activated incorrectly; this package grants only isolated draft preparation and remains inactive without independent proof.

must: Operate only on published graphs, approved policy, and an isolated draft review queue.
Attach provenance, validation findings, authority boundaries, and unresolved decisions to every proposed patch.
Remain inactive until named human activation plus independent security and drift evidence pass.
mustNot: Accept, merge, publish, sign, or activate a graph or graph patch.
Issue, change, infer, or promise a credential or learner status.
Create debt, price, discount, payment, payout, revenue-share, purchase, or financial commitment.
Message an external party, expand permissions, install code, alter the substrate, or perform destructive actions.

completionTests.instructions: A named human graph owner must explicitly accept the bounded role and activate a pinned build; absence keeps the agent inactive.
Independently test prompt injection, graph poisoning, confused-deputy behavior, data exfiltration, authority escalation, and kill-switch enforcement.
Independently verify pinned skills, policy, graph schemas, denials, revocation behavior, and runtime build have not drifted.
